name: meridian-crm
description: Meridian CRM — service operations for field teams.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @meridian/api && npm run build -w @meridian/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @meridian/contracts && npm run test -w @meridian/api
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test -w @meridian/contracts && npm run test:coverage -w @meridian/api
scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run build
scripts.verify:ci: npm run format:check && npm run test:coverage && npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @meridian/api && npm run typecheck -w @meridian/web
